_note: 1_07 'Defend Bucky' — three bully waves in the school garage yard while Bucky takes scripted damage pressure, then the gate rendezvous and the skateboard give-back (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/1_07-defend-bucky.md). The defend-NPC loop is real: Bucky is a combat pawn on the player's team (enemies' swings can land on him, the player's can't), every other wave member takes him as PreferredVictim, his KO fires npc_ko:bucky and fails the stage (a retry revives him at full health). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 1-07 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the gate/garage-door prop choreography and the toolbox NIS are folded into dialogue beats; Bucky holds his ground (no cower-flee path set); the ending is a speech beat + the campaign on_pass (skateboard 437 = a ride, logged; force-completes the errand tutorial 1_E01; respect bullies 0 / nerds 65); the SK8_Examine pair-anim is a stub. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
